raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #47916.

`MambaPool.copy_from` copied the temporal state with `temporal[:, dst] = temporal[:, src]`. The right-hand side gathers every source slot into one temporary of `n * slot_bytes`. When radix COW copies several checkpoints in one scheduler step, that spike can exceed free VRAM and the step fails with CUDA OOM. The issue's reporter measured 2 OOM retries on a 12-request burst (GLM-5.3-Flash, TP=2, `--mem-fraction-static` 0.965); the failed allocation (285,212,672 B) was exactly 8 slots. Credit to the reporter for the diagnosis and measurements.

## Modifications

- Add `MambaPool._copy_temporal_slots`, which copies in chunks bounded by `_MAMBA_TEMPORAL_COPY_CHUNK_BYTES` (64 MiB, at least one slot per chunk). It is used by both the fused and the fallback branch of `copy_from`.
- A copy that fits in one chunk stays a single batched assignment, so small copies are unchanged.
- Chunking is only equivalent to the batched copy when src and dst slots are disjoint, which the fused conv copy in the same function already requires. Under `SGLANG_DEBUG_MEMORY_POOL` the helper asserts this when it actually chunks.
- The fallback branch's conv copy is left as is; its per-slot state is much smaller than the temporal state.
- Tests in `test_mamba_unittest.py`: chunk-boundary correctness on the fused and fallback paths, and a CUDA-only peak-memory regression test.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable to model outputs; the copy is value-identical for disjoint slots. `test_mamba_pool_copy_from_chunk_boundaries` checks every destination equals its source (5 slots, 2-slot chunks) and that no other slot changes, on both the fused and the fallback path.

Tests run on 1x H100 PCIe (torch 2.14.1+cu130, Python 3.12):

- With this change: the 3 `copy_from` tests pass (2 subtests), and `test_mamba_unittest.py` plus `test_mamba_slot_fused.py` pass (20 passed).
- With only `memory_pool.py` reverted to the base commit: `test_mamba_pool_copy_from_peak_memory_is_chunked` fails, so it guards the bug.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Same H100, using the unit-test pool (temporal slot = 36.0 MiB, bf16). "batched" is the old behaviour (chunk budget set to infinity); "chunked" is this change with the default 64 MiB budget. Peak extra memory is `max_memory_allocated` minus the baseline during one `copy_from`; time is the mean of 20 calls.

| slots | mode | extra MiB | ms/copy |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | batched | 36.0 | 0.242 |
| 1 | chunked | 36.0 | 0.241 |
| 2 | batched | 72.0 | 0.483 |
| 2 | chunked | 36.0 | 0.463 |
| 4 | batched | 144.0 | 0.936 |
| 4 | chunked | 36.0 | 0.906 |
| 8 | batched | 288.0 | 1.844 |
| 8 | chunked | 36.0 | 1.794 |

Peak extra memory no longer grows with the number of slots, and copy time is unchanged within noise. The 8-slot "batched" figure (288 MiB) matches the 285 MB allocation in the issue.

Not verified: an end-to-end burst test on a real hybrid model (GLM-5.3-Flash); the reporter's runtime patch used the same idea and showed 0 OOM retries.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). (checked with the pinned ruff 0.15.1 and isort 7.0.0)
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results (above).

@@ -117,6 +117,8 @@
 _MAMBA_DEBUG_ASSERTS = os.environ.get("SGLANG_MAMBA_DEBUG_ASSERTS", "0") == "1"
 
 GB = 1024 * 1024 * 1024
+# Arbitrary; no evidence this is the best chunk size for temporal state copies.
+_MAMBA_TEMPORAL_COPY_CHUNK_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024
 _is_cuda = is_cuda()
 _is_npu = is_npu()
 _is_cpu = is_cpu()
@@ -1182,6 +1184,30 @@ def clear_slots(self, indices: torch.Tensor):
         if temporal.numel() > 0:
             temporal.index_fill_(1, idx64, 0)
 
+    def _copy_temporal_slots(
+        self, *, src_indices: torch.Tensor, dst_indices: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> None:
+        temporal = self.mamba_cache.temporal
+        if temporal.numel() == 0:
+            return
+        num_slots = dst_indices.shape[0]
+        slot_bytes = temporal.element_size() * (temporal.numel() // temporal.shape[1])
+        step = max(1, _MAMBA_TEMPORAL_COPY_CHUNK_BYTES // slot_bytes)
+        if num_slots <= step:
+            temporal[:, dst_indices] = temporal[:, src_indices]
+            return
+        # A batched gather allocates num_slots * slot_bytes at once and can OOM
+        # under admission bursts; chunking requires disjoint src/dst slots.
+        if envs.SGLANG_DEBUG_MEMORY_POOL.get():
+            overlap = set(src_indices.tolist()) & set(dst_indices.tolist())
+            assert not overlap, (
+                "chunked temporal copy requires disjoint src/dst slots; "
+                f"overlap={sorted(overlap)}"
+            )
+        for start in range(0, num_slots, step):
+            chunk = slice(start, start + step)
+            temporal[:, dst_indices[chunk]] = temporal[:, src_indices[chunk]]
+
     def copy_from(self, src_indices: torch.Tensor, dst_indices: torch.Tensor):
         """Clone mamba state (conv + temporal) from src slots into dst slots.
 
@@ -1211,17 +1237,13 @@ def copy_from(self, src_indices: torch.Tensor, dst_indices: torch.Tensor):
                     f"overlap={sorted(overlap)}"
                 )
             fused_copy_conv_slots(self._conv_slot_desc, src_indices, dst_indices)
-            temporal = self.mamba_cache.temporal
-            if temporal.numel() > 0:
-                temporal[:, dst_indices] = temporal[:, src_indices]
+            self._copy_temporal_slots(src_indices=src_indices, dst_indices=dst_indices)
         else:
             for i in range(len(self.mamba_cache.conv)):
                 self.mamba_cache.conv[i][:, dst_indices] = self.mamba_cache.conv[i][
                     :, src_indices
                 ]
-            self.mamba_cache.temporal[:, dst_indices] = self.mamba_cache.temporal[
-                :, src_indices
-            ]
+            self._copy_temporal_slots(src_indices=src_indices, dst_indices=dst_indices)
         if self.replayssm_write_pos is not None:
             self.replayssm_write_pos[dst_indices] = 0
         for sibling in self._slot_siblings:

@@ -9,6 +9,7 @@
 from sglang.srt.configs.mamba_utils import Mamba2CacheParams, Mamba2StateShape
 from sglang.srt.environ import envs
 from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import Req
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache import memory_pool as memory_pool_module
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.allocator import TokenToKVPoolAllocator
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import (
     HybridLinearKVPool,
@@ -462,6 +463,63 @@ def aligned_for(chunk_size, track_seqlens, prefix_lens):
         server_args._mamba_cache_chunk_size = FLA_CHUNK_SIZE
         set_global_server_args_for_scheduler(server_args)
 
+    def _temporal_slot_bytes(self, mamba_pool):
+        temporal = mamba_pool.mamba_cache.temporal
+        return temporal.element_size() * temporal.numel() // temporal.shape[1]
+
+    def test_mamba_pool_copy_from_chunk_boundaries(self):
+        """copy_from must copy every slot exactly once when the slot count is not a
+        multiple of the chunk size, on both the fused and the fallback path."""
+        _, req_to_token_pool, _ = self._setup_pools()
+        mamba_pool = req_to_token_pool.mamba_pool
+        temporal = mamba_pool.mamba_cache.temporal
+        slot_bytes = self._temporal_slot_bytes(mamba_pool)
+        num_slots = 5
+        src = req_to_token_pool.mamba_allocator.alloc(num_slots)
+        dst = req_to_token_pool.mamba_allocator.alloc(num_slots)
+        temporal[:, src] = torch.randn_like(temporal[:, src])
+        expected = temporal[:, src].clone()
+        untouched = temporal.clone()
+        untouched[:, dst] = expected
+
+        for disable_fused in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(disable_fused=disable_fused):
+                temporal[:, dst] = 0
+                with (
+                    envs.SGLANG_DISABLE_FUSED_MAMBA_SLOT_OPS.override(disable_fused),
+                    patch.object(
+                        memory_pool_module,
+                        "_MAMBA_TEMPORAL_COPY_CHUNK_BYTES",
+                        2 * slot_bytes,
+                    ),
+                ):
+                    mamba_pool.copy_from(src, dst)
+                torch.testing.assert_close(temporal[:, dst], expected)
+                torch.testing.assert_close(temporal, untouched)
+
+    @unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "needs CUDA memory stats")
+    def test_mamba_pool_copy_from_peak_memory_is_chunked(self):
+        """A burst copy_from must not allocate one temporary for all source slots;
+        its peak extra memory stays near the chunk budget, not n * slot size."""
+        _, req_to_token_pool, _ = self._setup_pools()
+        mamba_pool = req_to_token_pool.mamba_pool
+        slot_bytes = self._temporal_slot_bytes(mamba_pool)
+        num_slots = 8
+        src = req_to_token_pool.mamba_allocator.alloc(num_slots)
+        dst = req_to_token_pool.mamba_allocator.alloc(num_slots)
+
+        with patch.object(
+            memory_pool_module, "_MAMBA_TEMPORAL_COPY_CHUNK_BYTES", 2 * slot_bytes
+        ):
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
+            baseline = torch.cuda.memory_allocated()
+            mamba_pool.copy_from(src, dst)
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            extra = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() - baseline
+
+        self.assertLessEqual(extra, 3 * slot_bytes)
+
     def test_mamba_pool_cpu_offload(self):
         """MambaPool.get_cpu_copy / load_cpu_copy round-trips conv and temporal state."""
         _, req_to_token_pool, _ = self._setup_pools()
